title: feat: knowledge-graph view, recent-projects switcher, and editor-shell polish

commits.message:
feat(toolbar): responsive overflow menu, shortcut tooltips, and table command

Toolbar now collapses buttons it can't fit into an overflow (…) menu via a
ResizeObserver-driven layout pass, shows keyboard-shortcut tooltips (platform-
normalized through formatShortcut), and consolidates button construction in a
wireButton helper with CSS-only hover. Adds an insertTable formatting action
plus a 'table' slash command that inserts a GFM pipe table. Sample vault gains
a Tables.md demonstrating the output.

feat(core): fenced code-block card with copy/format toolbar and richer highlighting

Replaces the minimal copy-button widget with a full code-block card: a header
toolbar (language label, Wrap, Format, Copy, Edit) over syntax-highlighted
output. live-preview-highlight gains highlightCodeToHtml + formatCodeSource,
many more languages/aliases, and hljs v11 scope handling. Inline images no
longer expand the content area (block img, max-width:100%) and keep their
compact preview when the caret sits just after them.

feat(core): runtime line-number toggle and default soft-wrap

Adds EditorConfig.lineNumbers / lineWrapping and an EditorAPI.setLineNumbers
runtime toggle (line numbers moved into a Compartment for reconfiguration).
Soft-wrap is on by default so long unbreakable tokens (base64 data URLs, long
links) can't expand the content area past the viewport.

feat(demo): frameless window chrome, image IO, and recent-vault IPC

Main process gains custom window chrome (hiddenInset on macOS, frameless
min/max/close on Windows/Linux via window:* IPC), vault image handlers
(vault:write-image for paste/drop, vault:import-image for the picker), and
non-pruning recents handlers (vault:list-recents returns {path,name,exists},
vault:remove-recent) that keep dead entries so the UI can warn instead of
silently dropping them. Preload exposes the matching bridge (WindowBridge,
RecentVault types). Adds an inline-SVG icon set and the frameless window
controls widget.

feat(demo): editorial theme palettes and runtime color scheme

Adds DESIGN.md-derived light/dark editorial palettes and applyShellColorScheme,
which drives html[data-theme] so chrome, panels, and menus follow the editor's
light/dark toggle. settingsToTheme merges the design palette over the base
theme; settings modal migrated to nx-modal classes.

feat(demo): image insert, paste, drop, and fullscreen preview

Wires onAssetUpload so pasted/dropped images persist into the vault (img/),
adds a toolbar image picker (insertImageWithPicker via vault.importImage), and
a fullscreen lightbox (openImagePreview) on image click. Editor construction
moves lineNumbers/tabSize/direction/indentGuides into the config and applies
the shell color scheme on settings change.

refactor(demo): migrate panels to nx design-system classes

Drops the inline *_STYLES constants across the vault, backlinks, outline, and
search panels in favor of shared nx-* classes / --ds-* tokens. The vault panel
also gains a resizable + collapsible sidebar (persisted width), a background
context menu for root file/folder creation, and empty-state CTAs; buttons use
aria-disabled instead of native disabled so tooltips stay live.

refactor(demo): modularize shell styles into SCSS partials

Splits the 1.5k-line style.css (plus tokens.css/scrollbars.css) into modular
SCSS under styles/: main.scss @use-s partials in the original cascade order,
_variables.scss centralizes z-index magic numbers, _mixins.scss holds a
truncate mixin, and _switcher.scss is written with nesting as a showcase.
Styles now import from app.ts (Vite compiles SCSS); the <link> is dropped from
index.html. sass added as a devDependency. Verified byte-equivalent to the
pre-split minified bundle (modulo a harmless @charset).

feat(demo): knowledge-graph view of the vault wiki-link network

LinkIndex.getGraph() exposes the vault's forward-link graph as nodes+edges,
including unresolved wiki-link targets as ghost nodes (with degree counts for
sizing). graph-view.ts renders it on a canvas with a cooled force simulation:
drag to pin nodes, wheel-zoom around the cursor, pan, hover to spotlight
neighbours, click a resolved node to open it. Theme-aware via --ds-* tokens,
caps at 500 nodes, and idles cheaply when settled. Unit tests cover getGraph
(edges, ghosts, degree, self/anchor links).

feat(demo): recent-projects quick switcher

A centered modal (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+P) listing recently opened vaults from
vault.listRecents(). Existing projects switch on click/Enter with keyboard
navigation; projects whose folder was moved or deleted show a friendly hint
and a one-click Remove (vault.removeRecent) so the list self-heals. jsdom tests
cover rendering, switching, removal, and the empty state.

fix(core): align table widget with code blocks and remove phantom scrollbar

Wraps the table in an inset shell mirroring the fenced-code-block shell so the
two line up (12px inset, tracked padding instead of untracked margin). The
wrapper becomes a full-width block (was inline-block, which defeated the
table's width:100%). The last column's resize handle no longer overhangs the
edge. Height estimate updated for the shell padding. Combined with dropping the
wrapper's overflow-x:auto (see styles), tables no longer show a spurious
scrollbar when their content fits.

feat(demo): wire graph, switcher, and window chrome into the app shell

Assembles the new shell: custom chrome toolbar with icon buttons + file menu,
knowledge-graph overlay (Ctrl+Shift+G), project switcher (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+P),
and platform window controls. Adds refreshDocumentPanels() called after every
silent loadDocument so the outline (and backlinks) refresh on file open —
previously the outline stayed empty because silent loads skip the change
event.

docs: add DESIGN.md design specification

Editorial design spec (color tokens, typography scale, spacing, component
inventory) that the shell theme and --ds-* tokens are derived from.
